import collections, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for p in ('1','2','3'):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); cells=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if gi[y][x]==8]
    bb_r=[y for y,_ in cells]; bb_c=[x for _,x in cells]
    # ring = Chebyshev distance from bbox center (of bbox containing the blob)
    cy=(min(bb_r)+max(bb_r))/2; cx=(min(bb_c)+max(bb_c))/2
    ring=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
    for y,x in cells:
        dr=max(abs(y-cy),abs(x-cx)); ring[dr][go[y][x]]+=1
    print(p,'ring:',{int(k):dict(v) for k,v in sorted(ring.items())})

import collections, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Gather (hlen,vlen,first,last,top,bot) -> color across all demos
tab=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
for p in ('1','2','3'):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if gi[y][x]!=8: continue
            row=[gi[y][j]==8 for j in range(W)]
            col=[gi[i][x]==8 for i in range(H)]
            a=x
            while a>0 and row[a-1]: a-=1
            b=x
            while b<W-1 and row[b+1]: b+=1
            h=b-a+1
            c=y
            while c>0 and col[c-1]: c-=1
            d=y
            while d<H-1 and col[d+1]: d+=1
            v=d-c+1
            k=(h,v,a==x,b==x,c==y,d==y)
            tab[k][go[y][x]]+=1
for k in sorted(tab): print(k, dict(tab[k]))

import collections, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def quad_score(p, rowsep, colsep):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); bad=0; n=0
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if gi[y][x]!=8: continue
            q=((y<rowsep),(x<colsep))
            key=q
            if key in seen_p.get(p,{}) and go[y][x]!=seen_p[p][key]: bad+=1
            else: seen_p.setdefault(p,{})[key]=go[y][x]
            n+=1
    return n-bad
for p in ('1','2','3'):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']
    rows=sorted(set(y for y in range(7) if any(v==8 for v in gi[y])))
    cols=sorted(set(x for x in range(7) if any(v==8 for v in gi[x])))
    print(p,'rows',rows,'cols',cols)
print('seen_p from quad_score above:' )

    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    ys=[y for y in range(H) if any(v==8 for v in gi[y])]
    xs=[x for x in range(W) if any(v==8 for v in gi[y] for y in [0])]
    x0,x1=min(xs),max(xs); y0,y1=min(ys),max(ys)
    def run_len(gi,y,x,axis):
        n=1
        if axis==0 and y>0 and gi[y-1][x]==8: n+=1
        if axis==1 and y<H-1 and gi[y+1][x]==8: n+=1
        if axis==0 and x>0 and gi[y][x-1]==8: n+=1
        if axis==1 and x<W-1 and gi[y][x+1]==8: n+=1
        return n
    rec={}
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):

            u=y-y0; v=x-x0; U=y1-y0; V=x1-x0
            h=run_len(gi,y,x,0); v=run_len(gi,y,x,1)
            f=dict(u=u,v=v,U=U,V=V,h=h,vl=v,
                   top=u==0,bottom=u==U,left=v==0,right=v==V,
                   corner=u==0 and v==0, edge_h=u==0 or u==U, edge_v=v==0 or v==V,
                   diag=u==v, anti=u+U-1==v, par_u=u%2, par_v=v%2,
                   sum_=u+v, diff=u-v, prod=u*v, h_gt_v=h>v, v_gt_h=v>h, h_eq_v=h==v)
            rec[(y,x)]=f
    return rec
for p in ('1','2','3'):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    fr=feats(gi,go)
    print('=== demo',p)
    for (y,x),c in sorted(go.items()):
        f=fr[(y,x)]
        key=tuple(sorted(f.items()))
        print(y,x,'color',c,'feat',key)

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for c in comps(gi):
        ys=[y for y,_ in c]; xs=[x for _,x in c]

        for y,x in c:
            sdy=(y>by)-(y<by); sdx=(x>bx)-(x<bX if False else (x>bx)-(x<bx))
            q={'T' if sdy<=0 else 'B'}+('L' if sdx<0 else 'R')

            col={'TL':1,'TR':4,'BL':3,'BR':2}[q]

    return out
